claims: Steven Pearl is the head coach of the Auburn Tigers men’s basketball team.
Steven Pearl took over the head coach position of the Auburn Tigers men’s basketball team for the 2025–26 season.
Bruce Pearl is the father of Steven Pearl.
Bruce Pearl retired from the head coach position of the Auburn Tigers men’s basketball team.
Bruce Pearl transitioned to an ambassador role within the athletic department.
Bruce Pearl had an 11-year tenure as head coach of the Auburn Tigers men’s basketball team.
Bruce Pearl stepped down in September 2025.
Steven Pearl was the associate head coach of the Auburn Tigers men’s basketball team prior to 2025.
Larry Vickers is the head coach of the Auburn women's basketball team.
